description: This file defines a React functional component named Topbar, which renders a user interface component showing global actions and an offline queue indicator in a CRM application.

methods.name: Topbar()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the top navigation bar with controls for theme toggle, offline queue sync, search, and navigation buttons.

methods.name: onThemeToggle
methods.description: Event handler that toggles the UI theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: onSync
methods.description: Event handler that synchronizes queued operations with the server and notifies if there is nothing to sync.
